The short vowel is substituted in the neuter, for the final vowel, of a प्रातिपदिक।

Terms: प्रातिपदिक

A short vowel is called लघु 'light'.

Terms: घि पति

, come in expressing shortness of length or diminutive.

Terms: क

To a root ending in a short vowel is added the augment त् (तुक्) when a कृत्-affix having an indicatory ए follows.

Terms: विभक्ति-छन्दस्

In a मन्त्र , the सुट् is added to चन्द्र when it is second member in a compound and is preceded by a short vowel.

Terms: सुट् augment
The otherwise unaccented मत् (वत्) takes the acute accent, when an oxytoned stem ends in a light vowel, or the affix has before it the augment न्
When the compound ends in a light vowel the acute accent (उदात्त) falls on the syllable before such last, in a बहुव्रीहि समास preceded by नञ् and सु to which the affix कप् -- नद्यृतश्च

, is added.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term
The augment न् is added before the Genitive 6th-Case plural ending आम् after the अङ्ग (stems) ending in a short vowel after अङ्ग (stems) called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी

etc., and after the अङ्ग (stems) ending in the feminine affix आ।

Terms: नुम् / नुट् augment

For the short इ and उ final in a nominal-stem, a गुण is substituted in the Vocative Case singular.

Terms: गुण in Feminine

A short is substituted for the long vowel of the reduplicate.

Terms: Reduplicate

The स् is elided before an affix beginning with झल् consonant (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) when it is preceded by a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a short vowel.

Terms: स् Elision

ष् is substituted for the final स् preceded by a उ before a तद्धित affix beginning with त।

Terms: षत्व change
